mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_token (user_id, fcm_token, device_type, is_active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fcmToken}, #{deviceType}, TRUE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE device_token_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(device_token_id), user_id = VALUES(user_id), device_type = VALUES(device_type), is_active = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT device_token_id, user_id, fcm_token, device_type, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM device_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY device_token_id
mapper.update: UPDATE device_token SET is_active = FALSE WHERE fcm_token = #{fcmToken} AND is_active = TRUE
